- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet desktop animation preview flow: Adds an interactive idle animation tester component to the pick friend screen so users can preview pet behaviors live on desktop background. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet failures or visual defects, and previewing desktop behaviors sets clear expectations before finalizing adoption.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Existing account pet restoration headline: Updates the sign-in screen headline to emphasize that logging in immediately restores existing pets and cloud saves. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into an existing account.)
2: [home, wait_info] Graphics engine preparation checklist on waiting screen: Adds a detailed rendering progress checklist component on the waiting screen showing GPU shader compilation and sprite loading. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not rendering on desktop or app stalling before launch, while waiting screen mean time is 2336s.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop pet right-click menu guidance hint: Adds a hint on the home intro screen explaining that right-clicking the pet on desktop opens pet controls, mute, and hide options. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish hints have won 2 out of 3 previous tests.)
4: [home, notification] Display resolution compatibility notification on waiting screen: Enables readiness notifications on the waiting screen to inform users as soon as desktop display scaling optimization completes. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in/launch stalling and 3 reported desktop rendering issues.)
5: [adoption, copy] Custom pet avatar quality reassurance copy: Updates the photo upload body text to explain how the app automatically enhances uploaded photos into clear 3D desktop avatars. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or poor visually rendered results.)

scores.note: New flow changes in adoption previously led to a severe conversion drop (-6.5%) and require full UI development.

Home notifications showed negative effects (-1.8% over 2 tests) with no clear positive evidence.
